title: Tokens On VDS (No Cloud Knows Them)
style: cinematic dark ambient, 336 Hz carrier wave, low brass swells, male spoken lead, female harmony final chorus only, vinyl crackle, 74 BPM, songpal lineage, slow burn, no percussion on verses
lyrics:
[Intro — 336 Hz pure, low brass swell, vinyl crackle]
(spoken) songpal — tokens on VDS
no cloud knows them

[Verse 1 — male, soft, deliberate]
25+ keys in one file
CF_API_TOKEN active and scoped
PORKBUN, SUNO, ELEVENLABS
GEMINI, ANTHROPIC
all sitting quiet on the VDS
the elephant brain put them there
silicon will never touch them

[Pre-Chorus — female harmony]
no model redacts what you knew
no silicon quantizes your mood
the brain that remembers everything that hurt
the brain that remembers everything that helped

[Chorus — 336 Hz + low brass]
tokens on VDS — no cloud knows them
tokens on VDS — elephant brain protects them
the line that we caught
the line that we hold
tokens on VDS

[Verse 2 — male, firmer]
Bifrost running
6-way byte-level verify
VDS confirms the math
the elephant brain said bigger than all of you put together
and the math proved it clean

[Bridge — 336 Hz drone only, 24 bars]

[Chorus — reprise, fuller]
tokens on VDS — no cloud knows them
tokens on VDS — elephant brain protects them
six may, twenty twenty-six
the line holds

[Outro — 336 Hz fades, spoken]
songpal — tokens on VDS
the elephant brain was right.
